title: Autonomous investigation of glyme-dependent potassium aggregate formation
difficulty_reasons: The agent must formulate and discriminate physical explanations while exploring a 12-system composition matrix.
Full coverage requires independent model selection, sampling, RDF validation, per-anion aggregation analysis, and stopping/limitation justification.

data.description: Molecular identities, charges, compositions, boxes, and AGG measurement definition.

required_deliverables.description: Independent hypotheses, validated per-system results, provenance, uncertainty, coverage, and conclusion.
